author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Bill from @NerdNest challenged me to fill out this (surprisingly challenging) grid of game choices, and the whole exercise was so interesting that I decided to make a video explaining my selections. Here are my favorite games in a variety of different categories.

Fill it out yourself: https://grids.fun/t/about-me-video-games-dcefq
Wiimote guide: https://youtu.be/bvLfxMzm_ak
